en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Aban Bin Usman, from Fuzayl Bin Yasar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Myasws fatherasws wore the armour of Rasool-Allahsaww, Zat Al-Fuzoul, so it made lines (dragging on the ground), and Iasws wore it, so it was surplus (bigger)’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from Fudayl ibn Yasar from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following. “
My father wore the Dhat al-Fdul, coat of arms of the Messenger of Allah and being taller for him it left marks on the ground. I wore it and it was taller for me also.”
